visual_events.description: A high-angle overhead shot looks directly down along a single visible course of red bricks laid on edge in an alternating header-stretcher arrangement that forms rectangular hollow cavities down the centre of the wall. Wet grey mortar patches rest on the top edges and cross-joints of the bricks, and loose mortar droppings and sandy debris are visible inside the open cavities as well as spilled along both sides of the base on the sandy ground. From 00.0s to about 05.5s, the camera tilts and moves slightly backward/upward along the wall axis, bringing the bottom edge of a stack of red bricks into view at the upper right (around 03.0s) and a person's foot wearing a dark sandal into the upper-left corner (entering around 04.6s and settling by 05.8s). From about 05.8s to 08.170667s, the camera and the sandaled foot remain virtually stationary.
